title: 救命浮環ステーション
description: 厚みのある浮環、4本の帯、つかみ綱、投てき索リール、支持金具を備える静的な設備モデル。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A static station with thick ring, four bands, grab rope, throwline reel and support brackets; no safety certification is claimed. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
